verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents dashboards or trend views across projects and teams. The closest items are adjacent: a per-version view of which code versions throw exceptions, deploy tracking that 'unlocks features', and a Metrics tag in the API spec. A per-release view, a debugging aid and an API a developer could build dashboards on do not deliver top regressions, new issues per release, or volume-over-time dashboards.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time
